doReMi.description: Sing through the scale — DO RE MI FA SO LA TI DO. Hold each note for a few seconds to advance.

toneDetector.description: Detect multiple simultaneous tones in real time. Sing a harmony and see which notes are sounding.

piano.name: Piano

singTone.name: Sing Tone Game
singTone.description: A random tone is played — sing it back! Match different tones in a row to win.

pitchGame.name: Pitch Game
pitchGame.description: Target notes scroll in — sing each one and hold it to score. Race the clock and hit as many as you can.

warmUp.name: Vocal Warm-Up
warmUp.description: Warm up your voice through a guided pitch sequence — hold each note to advance.

singingTools.name: Music Tools
singingTools.description: Find your pitch and get perfectly in tune.

singingGames.name: Singing Games
singingGames.description: Games to train your ear and voice.

singFly.name: Singfly

graceKelly.name: Grace Kelly Challenge
graceKelly.description: Sing along to MIKA's "Grace Kelly". Pick a harmony part and follow the tones.

toneDetector.pageDescription: Detects multiple tones at once (C2–C7). Sing a harmony, hum several notes and see each tone displayed in real time.
toneDetector.sensitivityDescription: How quiet a note can be next to the loudest one and still show up. Raise it to catch soft voices in a chord.
toneDetector.noiseGateDescription: Sets the minimum volume required to detect a tone. Raise it if you see false tones during silence. Lower it to pick up quieter sounds.
